title: Vehicle Entry and Ticket Issuance
overview: The entry service creates one open parking session per accepted vehicle and rejects entry when no capacity remains.
preconditions: The entry gate can reach the ticket service.
main_flow: The gate sends a normalized vehicle number and idempotency key.
The system checks occupancy against capacity.
The system creates an OPEN ticket with a server timestamp.
The system increments occupancy in the same transaction.
The gate returns the ticket and opens.

alternative_flows.result: Do not create a ticket and return LOT_FULL.
Return the existing ticket without changing occupancy.

business_rules: Ticket IDs are unique external identifiers.
Vehicle numbers are trimmed and uppercased.
Ticket creation and occupancy increment are atomic.
